= Overview =
The Community Mod Menu (CMM) is part of the [[Community Mod Framework]] and allows multiple mods to hook into a single shared in-game settings menu through a registration API. For full documentation, see the [https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki GitHub wiki].

[[File:CMM_Example_Mod.png|thumb|600px|The CMM Example Mod.]]

= CMM Visual Editor =
CMM provides a [https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/CMM-Visual-Editor visual editor tool] that generates all required files from a browser-based interface, with no manual coding required.

Run in a terminal to launch:
<syntaxhighlight lang="powershell">
curl.exe -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/main/tools/cmm-visual-editor.bat -o "$env:TEMP\cmm-visual-editor.bat"; & "$env:TEMP\cmm-visual-editor.bat"
</syntaxhighlight>

= Basic Setup =
Register your mod by creating a registration effect and hooking it into CMM's <code>on_action</code>:

<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
# in_game/common/scripted_effects/your_effects.txt
your_mod_register = {
	# Register settings here
}

# in_game/common/on_action/your_on_action.txt
cmm_on_mod_registration = {
	on_actions = {
		your_mod_on_register
	}
}

your_mod_on_register = {
	effect = {
		your_mod_register = yes
	}
}
</syntaxhighlight>

Then create a Scripted GUI file and a localization file for your settings.

= Setting Types =

== Quick Reference ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Registration Effect !! Callback Helper !! Value
|-
| Toggle || <code>cmm_register_bool_setting</code> || <code>cmm_toggle_bool_setting</code> || <code>var:</code> (0/1)
|-
| Dropdown || <code>cmm_register_dropdown_setting</code> || <code>cmm_apply_dropdown_change</code> || <code>var:</code> (ordinal from 1)
|-
| Button || <code>cmm_register_button_setting</code> || ''(custom effect)'' || No stored value
|-
| Numeric || <code>cmm_register_numeric_setting</code> || <code>cmm_apply_numeric_change</code> || <code>var:</code> (number)
|-
| Slider || <code>cmm_register_slider_setting</code> || <code>cmm_apply_slider_change</code> || <code>var:</code> (number)
|-
| Text || <code>cmm_register_text_setting</code> || ''(scripted effect callback)'' || <code>$text$</code> param
|-
| Settings List || <code>cmm_register_settings_list</code> || <code>cmm_apply_list_change</code> || Per-field variables
|}

All types except text and settings list have global variants (<code>cmm_register_global_*</code>) that store values in <code>global_var:</code> and are host-editable in multiplayer.

== Registration Pattern ==
All settings share this pattern — register the setting, then create a <code>[mod_id]__[setting_id]_on_changed</code> Scripted GUI callback:

<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
# Registration (inside your registration effect)
cmm_register_bool_setting = {
	mod_id = your_mod
	setting_id = your_toggle
	tab_id = general
	group_id = general_toggles
	default_value = 0
}

# Scripted GUI callback
your_mod__your_toggle_on_changed = {
	scope = country

	effect = {
		cmm_toggle_bool_setting = {
			setting = your_mod__your_toggle
		}
	}
}
</syntaxhighlight>

Text settings use a '''scripted effect''' callback instead. The submitted text is available as <code>$text$</code>.

== Reading Values ==
* Basic settings: <code>var:[mod_id]__[setting_id]</code>
* Global settings: <code>global_var:[mod_id]__[setting_id]</code>
* List fields: <code>var:[mod_id]__[setting_id]_item_[N]_field_[slot]</code>
* List item values: <code>scope:cmm_list_current_item_value</code> (inside <code>cmm_for_each_list_item</code>)

== Conditional Visibility ==
Any Scripted GUI callback can include <code>is_shown</code> to conditionally hide a setting:

<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
your_mod__your_toggle_on_changed = {
	scope = country

	is_shown = {
		var:your_mod__some_other_setting = 1
	}

	effect = {
		cmm_toggle_bool_setting = {
			setting = your_mod__your_toggle
		}
	}
}
</syntaxhighlight>

= Localization =

== Quick Reference ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Key Pattern !! Description
|-
| <code>[mod_id]_name</code> / <code>_desc</code> || Mod name / description
|-
| <code>[mod_id]__[tab_id]_name</code> / <code>_desc</code> || Tab name / description
|-
| <code>[mod_id]__[group_id]_name</code> / <code>_desc</code> || Group name / description
|-
| <code>[mod_id]__[setting_id]_name</code> / <code>_desc</code> || Setting name / description
|-
| <code>[mod_id]__[setting_id]_option_[N]_name</code> || Dropdown option label
|-
| <code>[mod_id]__[setting_id]_text</code> || Button text
|-
| <code>[mod_id]__[setting_id]_item_column_name</code> || List item column header
|-
| <code>[mod_id]__[setting_id]_item_[N]_name</code> || List row label
|-
| <code>[mod_id]__[setting_id]__[field_id]_name</code> || List field column label
|-
| <code>[mod_id]__[setting_id]__[field_id]_option_[N]_name</code> || List dropdown field option
|}
